messages:
acme_admin: Hey team — after we merged two orgs today, our free-tier credits dropped to 0 instantly and promo credits stayed at 50. Dashboard shows free credits used first, invoice shows promo credits burned first. Can someone explain?

maria_billing: @acme_admin sorry about that — can you paste the org IDs involved and the timestamp of the merge?

acme_admin: org-old: org_8484, org-new: org_9932, merge ran 2025-11-03T15:02:12Z. No other changes.

sam_support: thanks — sending this to billing and infra. Quick q: did you have any reserved capacity or dedicated plans tied to either org?

acme_admin: no reserved capacity. Both on free tier + 50 promo credits on org_9932.

jordan_engineering: logging in — seems like a burn-priority flag got reset during the merge. On merge we should preserve per-org credit priority (promo > free). Looks like free was promoted to primary wallet incorrectly.

maria_billing: I can see the transactions: snapshots show free credits allocated to the combined org and then consumed by background jobs at 15:03:xx. Invoice lines show tokens billed to promo pool at 15:03:45. That mismatch explains the dashboard vs invoice diff.

acme_admin: okay — can we restore the free credits? They were supposed to last another 12 days.

sam_support: we need to repro and then run a targeted wallet-recompute for your org. @jordan can you share the admin query we should run?

jordan_engineering: run this in admin console (read-only):
```
SELECT wallet_id, pool_type, balance, last_updated
FROM credit_wallets
WHERE org_id IN ('org_8484','org_9932')
ORDER BY last_updated DESC;
```
That shows pre/post-merge allocation.

jordan_engineering: also check the merge job log: `/var/log/merges/2025-11-03_15-merge-org_9932.log` — it contains the wallet migration steps. Noticed an error: `WARN: missing burn_priority; defaulting to free` around 15:02:59.

maria_billing: escalation checklist for billing ops: 1) run wallet recompute for org_9932 2) move remaining promo credits to primary consumption pool 3) re-credit free credits to org with correct expiry 4) re-run billing reconciliation for 15:00-15:10 window and regenerate invoice lines if needed.

billing-bot: action created: BILL-PRIORITY-786 (assigned to maria_billing). ETA 4h.

acme_admin: thanks — any risk of double-crediting when you re-run recon? We don't want duplicates.

maria_billing: we'll run an idempotent recompute. steps: snapshot current state, compute delta between on-chain events and accounting ledger, apply only positive deltas to free pool. I'll post the exact commands before applying.

sam_support: for repro we also need a minimal script that simulates merge. @alex_devex can you share a dev script?

alex_devex: yep — use the sandbox: POST /admin/merge_orgs with body:
```json
{ "source_org_id": "org_8484", "target_org_id": "org_9932", "simulate": true }
```
Then inspect `/admin/credits?org=org_9932` for wallet state. This sim uses the same merge code path but runs against staging.

acme_admin: I ran simulate in staging and see the same behavior — free moved to primary. This confirms prod bug.

jordan_engineering: good repro. Next steps: i'll patch merge service to preserve burn_priority and add a unit test. Patch PR incoming.

maria_billing: billing ops will run recompute now in a maintenance window and not touch invoices yet — we'll validate then decide on invoice regen.

acme_admin: appreciated. Please keep me posted.

maria_billing: will do. I'll update thread when recompute completes (BILL-PRIORITY-786). :white_check_mark:
